plugins.description: Automatic conversation naming plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): names the first prompt and streams AI title suggestions in the rename dialog.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-auto-rename **Automatic conversation naming for DeepSeek Harness.** The first prompt names itself, and the rename dialog streams AI suggestions. [![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.1.0-4176e6)](package.json) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4176e6)](LICENSE) [![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2-6b7280)](#known-limits) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A522.19-6b7280)](package.json) English · [中文](README.zh.md)
--- ## Features **Names the first prompt.** When a session sends its first message and the title is still empty, a title is generated — once, from that message alone. A manual rename pins the title afterwards, so it is never rewritten under your hands. **Suggests titles when you rename.** The **AI Name** button sits at the top of the conversation page. Its dialog looks and behaves like DSH's native rename window, with three extra things: | | | |---|---| | Streaming candidates | Suggestions arrive one at a time (NDJSON), each revealed by a 500 ms left-to-right sweep | | One-click apply | Click a chip to fill the input; **Regenerate** for a fresh set | | Native feel | Enter confirms, Esc closes, and Enter during IME composition never submits by mistake | **Uses a model you choose.** Naming follows the conversation's main model by default, or pins a cheaper one. The dropdown is built from the host's `remote.session.modelCatalog()`, which enumerates providers one by one and drops those that return nothing — so every entry is a model the host has actually authenticated and can really call. **Leaves the audit trail.** The provider id `dsh-auto-rename` is written into `source.provider` of every `session/title` event, so you can always tell which titles this plugin produced.
Why it builds its own dialog instead of extending the native one The native rename window is an internal host component with no extension point: `RenameForm` declares no injectable slot, the `requestSessionRename` it needs is passed only as a prop into sidebar menu items, and nothing in the bundle `ctx.provide`s it. The plugin can therefore neither insert a suggestion row into it nor open it programmatically. It builds its own dialog and copies the native window's CSS rules one by one, so the two are visually indistinguishable.
## Install ```sh dsh plugin add dsh-auto-rename ``` From a checkout instead: ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add ``` The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so installing it also inserts `dsh-auto-rename` into the profile's bundle stack **and disables the built-in `session-title-llm` row from dsh-base**. That second part is required: `SessionTitleService.register()` accepts exactly one provider globally, so if the built-in row registers first, this plugin's registration throws. Restart DSH afterwards. Client-side changes hot-reload; host-side changes need the restart. ## Settings Open the **AI Name** dialog and click the gear in its title row, left of the close button. The panel expands inside the same dialog. Edits are staged in a draft and written only when you press **Save**; an empty field means "use the default". | Field | Default | Notes | |---|---|---| | Rename on first prompt | on | Turning it off leaves suggestions working | | Naming model | Follow main model | Lists only models the host has authenticated and can currently list | | Suggestions | 3 | Candidates fetched per dialog open (1–5) | | Output limit (tokens) | 64 | Per-generation token cap | | Timeout (ms) | 60000 | Longest wait for one generated title | | Title width (CJK characters) | 12 | **The only length knob**; longer output is truncated | If the host has no remote assembled, or listing fails, the model row falls back to manual **Provider** / **Model** fields. They must be filled in pairs: a half-set route logs a warning at startup and errors clearly when used, rather than silently doing nothing. ## How it works **It reads only what you typed.** Neither path looks at assistant replies: automatic naming takes the first human message, suggestions take the three most recent ones so they describe the topic in progress rather than the opening line. Each message is clipped to `maxInputBytes` (default 4096) before it reaches the model, because the official shared implementation throws on oversized input. **Length is measured in display width, not characters.** One CJK character costs 2 half-width units, everything else — spaces included — costs 1. The budget is `Title width × 2`, so the default `12` allows 12 Chinese characters or 24 Latin characters including spaces, roughly 3–4 words. One knob governs both scripts; there is no separate word count for English, because word lengths vary too much for a count to mean anything. The official shared implementation still wants a `targetWords` value (prompt-only, never truncating), so it is derived from the same budget at ~6 units per word — `12` yields `4`. That keeps the model's target close to the hard cut instead of writing long and being trimmed. **Truncation avoids mangling words.** A cut landing mid-word falls back to the previous space, so you never get `sessio`. When there is no space to fall back to — a `provider/model` route, a URL — the title is left alone: slightly too wide beats a broken word.
Why the plugin has to truncate at all The official caller passes `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` as the truncation argument of `normalizeSessionTitle` — that is, no truncation whatsoever. The host does enforce a `maxTitleBytes` ceiling (80 bytes ≈ 26 CJK characters), but it is far too loose to keep titles short. So "not too long" is this plugin's job, and the practical ceiling of the width knob sits below the host's byte limit.
## Project layout ``` lib/config.js Pure logic: config merge, source-message picking, title truncation. Zero imports, testable on its own. lib/index.js Host half — registers the title provider and the HTTP bridge. lib/client.js Client half — header button, rename dialog, in-dialog settings panel. cordis.patch.yml Bundle patch: insert this plugin, disable built-in session-title-llm. locale/ Display metadata for the plugin manager (title, description). test/ Self-checks: logic, host apply, client render, locale audit, patch. ``` The two halves talk over three HTTP routes, each accepting loopback origins only (`127.0.0.1`, `::1`, `::ffff:127.0.0.1`) and rejecting `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`: | Route | Purpose | |---|---| | `POST /dsh-auto-rename/suggest` | Stream N candidate titles as NDJSON | | `POST /dsh-auto-rename/config` | Echo the currently effective config, for debugging | | `POST /dsh-auto-rename/settings` | Write config through the host `settings` service, whitelist-filtered | The write route answers **503** when the host `settings` service is absent, rather than reporting success it did not achieve. ## Development ```powershell npm run check ``` Six gates, all fast and all offline: 1. Syntax check of the host and config modules, plus a parse check of the client bundle. 2. Pure-logic self-test — config merge, message picking, the width budget and the byte budget. 3. Host `apply()` smoke against a fake context: metadata, degradation paths, provider shape, route guards, and the exact Config schema field list. 4. Client `apply()` smoke: renders the header entry and the settings panel for real, and covers all three catalog degradations. The fake context reproduces the host's restricted facade, including the fact that reading `ctx.inject` throws. 5. Locale audit: every dictionary key used in code exists in both zh and en. 6. Patch check: `cordis.patch.yml` disables the built-in row, inserts this one, and touches nothing else. The smokes need `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`. Locally, junction it from an installed profile: ```powershell New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path node_modules\@deepseek-ai\schemastery ` -Target "$e

plugins.description: dsh 插件：AI 选择题自动加一项「幸运方块」随机决定 + 说「回滚」撤销；界面上的骰子按钮长按挖穿即触发随机事件（写论文/我的世界概念合成/冷笑话/冷知识/时事新闻/弹窗表演/蓝屏屏保），整体致敬《赛博朋克 2077》的四季宝
plugins.readme_text:
# 幸运方块 (dsh-lucky-block)

一个 dsh 插件，同时工作在 dsh web 与 dsh desktop。两件事：

1. **幸运方块选项** —— AI 向你提选择题时，每个问题的选项末尾会自动多出一个「幸运方块」。
   选它，就随机替你挑一个选项、或把几个选项揉成一个新方案，全随机。
   不满意？说一句「回滚」（或打 `/rollback`），立刻回到上一版本。
2. **幸运方块按钮** —— 屏幕角落一个可拖动、可锁定的我的世界幸运方块（16×16 原版方块面贴图）。
   不知道干啥时**长按**它 1.4 秒：方块裂纹满布、碎成像素碎片，**耳边是原版 Minecraft 的敲石头声**，
   接着它会在你的默认工作区自动开一个新会话，**全程不需要你做任何事**地随机干一件事。
   松手时方块若离屏幕边缘够近（48px 以内）会**自动吸附贴边**。

按钮说话像个枪。**这个 AI 人格是一把会说话的智能手枪**：称呼你永远是「用户」，动不动
「音量提高 33%」，讲人体数据的冷知识，还哼 *bum bum be-dum bum bum be-dum bum*。
掷满 50 次它会**单向翻转**成礼貌模式（谁都拦不住）。闲下来 25 分钟以上它会冒一句碎嘴
—— 但它**从不往会话里写东西**，所以绝不会污染你的对话历史。

> 人设的性格参数（称呼、特质、音量台词、翻转后的台词）都在 `lib/persona.js` 的
> `DEFAULT_PERSONA` 里，可以用配置里的 `persona` 整段替换成你自己想要的性格。

## 骰子事件一览（共 8 个，按权重随机）

| 概率 | 事件 | 类型 | 会做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 18.2% | 随机冷知识闲聊 | AI | 随机抽一种闲聊口味（冷知识 / 硬核概念比喻 / 微型科幻 / 生活技巧 / 造个伪学科 / 假新闻），300 字内写完 |
| 18.2% | 时事新闻速览 | AI | **联网**检索 3 条最近真实新闻，每条一句事实 + 一句点评 + 来源链接；查不到就直说，绝不编 |
| 13.6% | 随机选题写论文 | AI | 随机词条拼出题目（如「边缘计算 × 古籍数字化 × 的鲁棒性研究」），写 4 节正文并落盘到 `lucky-block-papers/<hash>.md` |
| 13.6% | 我的世界概念合成 | AI | 随机抽两个 Minecraft 概念（红石比较器、潜影盒、雪傀儡……），按一张随机「合成表」模板把它们揉成一个新东西 |
| 13.6% | 冷笑话专场 | AI | 抽一条随机的笑话结构（谐音 / 荒谬逻辑 / 反向解读 / 机器视角 / 逻辑错位……）现编一个，讲完解释笑点为什么成立 |
| 9.1% | 无害弹窗表演 | 视觉 | 界面上连弹 24 个无意义提示框，再按创建顺序倒序全部关掉 |
| 9.1% | 蓝屏屏保（60 秒） | 视觉 | 全屏显示一份仿 Windows 蓝屏，60 秒后自动恢复，按 ESC 提前结束 |
| 9.1% | 随机整理待办 | AI | 列出工作区最近改的 5 个文件，随机分「紧急 / 不紧急」并明说自己不可信 |

**视觉类（弹窗 / 蓝屏）完全不建会话、不调 AI、零 token、零延迟** —— 点下去立刻演。
剩下 6 个才会开新会话。

清单可用 `node tools/list-events.mjs` 随时重新生成 —— 它直接从 `lib/index.js`
的 `buildEvents()` 里解析，不会和代码漂移。

## 设置面板（右键方块 → 设置…）

| 开关 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| 长按挖掘音效 | 循环挖掘声 + 碎裂声。关掉就完全静音 |
| 逐事件「不调用 AI」 | 勾中的事件直接从本地语料库取内容，零 token、瞬时返回 |

只有**自带本地库**的事件会出现勾选框，目前是「随机冷知识闲聊」和「冷笑话专场」：

| 本地库 | 条数 | 位置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 冷笑话 + 点评 | 353 条 + 30 条 | `lib/jokes-data.json` |
| 冷知识 | 818 条（人体 133 / 动物 139 / 科学 121 / 日常 111 / 历史 111 / 地理 103 / 语言 100） | `lib/trivia-data.json` |

冷知识库里分主题存的 `topic` **只用于统计，永远不显示给用户** —— 显示主题等于
把「这是一条从哪抽的」直接摊开。笑话的 `form` 字段同理。

两个库的**完整内容**可以在 [`lib/语料库总览.md`](<lib/语料库总览.md>) 里逐条翻阅；
那份文件由 `node tools/build-corpus-overview.mjs` 从运行库生成，改动语料后重跑即可
（`--check` 用于回归时校验它没过期）。

「时事新闻速览」必须联网，写进配置也会被忽略并记一条警告 —— 它没有本地库可退。

设置写在 `%DSH_HOME%\plugins\dsh-lucky-block\config.json`，是**手写与界面共用的同一个文件**
（界面保存走读-改-写，不会抹掉你手写的 `model` / `persona`）：

```json
{
  "sound": true,
  "localOnly": ["joke", "trivia"],
  "model": { "provider": "workbuddy", "model": "deepseek-v4.1-flash", "reasoningEffort": "low" }
}
```

## 安装（本地开发）

```bash
# 方式一：直接指向本目录（plugin-manager 支持本地 spec）
#   在插件市场里「安装」填本目录的绝对路径

# 方式二：npm 打包后按包装
npm pack
```

装完后**不需要**动 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`：宿主侧条目由本包
`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 自动插入，profile 的 patch 里再加一条同 id 的
`- insert:` 反而会造成组装冲突、让插件加载不上（实测踩过）。

只要确认 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里有
`"dsh-lucky-block"`（插件市场安装会自动加；手动装则加这一行）。

`"patchReload": "live"`（profile 自带）让 `cordis.patch.yml` 热生效；但**改动
`bundles` 列表必须重启 dsh**才生效。

> ⚠️ **改 `lib/` 下的任何 JS 都必须重启 dsh。** 宿主侧插件代码没有热重载 ——
> 正在跑的进程内存里持有旧模块，代码改了行为不会变。这个坑骗过一整轮排查：
> 源码里已经搜不到某段字符串，会话里却还在出现它，最后才发现是进程跑的是旧代码。
> 客户端那半（`lib/client.js`）刷新页面即可，但桌面端要重启宿主才会重新收集注入行。

## 可选配置：给骰子会话单独指定模型

**默认不启用**，骰子会话直接沿用你的默认模型。想让随机事件跑便宜/快的模型时，
在 `%DSH_HOME%\plugins\dsh-lucky-block\config.json` 写（这个字段只能手写，设置面板里没有）：

```json
{
  "model": {
    "provider": "workbuddy",
    "model": "deepseek-v4.1-flash",
    "reasoningEffort": "low"
  }
}
```

`reasoningEffort` 可省略。`provider` / `model` 必须**精确匹配**可用目录里的名字
（目录拿不到时会跳过切换、不影响掷骰子），不确定就先用 `/dice` 命令观察日志。

> ⚠️ **为什么默认关着**：宿主只提供会话级 `sessionController.selectModel`，而它
> 成功后会把这次选择**异步写成 profile 的全局默认模型**。也就是说开启本配置后，
> 第一次掷骰子会顺带把你的默认模型也改成这里写的那个。想恢复就把文件删掉，
> 再在界面里手动把默认模型选回来。

## 用法

| 想干什么 | 怎么做 |
| --- | --- |
| 让 AI 给选择题加幸运方块 | 正常提问，选项末尾自动多一项 |
| 抽一次 | **长按**幸运方块按钮（挖掘到碎裂）/ 打 `/dice` |
| 不满意，回去 | 说「回滚」或打 `/rollback` |
| 方块按钮固定住不挡路 | 右键方块 → 锁定（或双击）；锁定后仍可长按触发 |
| 让方块贴边 | 把它拖到离屏幕边缘 48px 以内松手，自动吸附 |
| 改设置 | 右键方块 → 设置… |

长按阈值 1.4 秒（`lib/client.js` 的 `BREAK_MS`）。按住时手指挪动超过 5 像素即判为
「在拖动按钮」并取消挖掘——所以拖位置和挖方块不会打架。松开或移开都会取消挖掘，
纹路和挖掘声**立刻**一起停。

音效从宿主的 `/dsh-lucky-block/sound/*.ogg` 按需取（16 个原版音节，共 142 KB），
**不内联进客户端 bundle** —— `lib/client.js` 是每次页面启动都要下载的入口，
为只在长按瞬间才用到的音效把它撑大 4 倍不划算。挖掘声每 210ms 一个、4 个变体随机轮播
（只听一个会明显「卡带」），挖穿那一刻再叠一声碎裂音；同时最多 6 个 Audio 元素，
页面切到后台自动静音。

松手吸附（`SNAP_THRESHOLD = 48`）只在**真的拖动过**时生效：鼠标只是滑出方块边缘
（会触发 `pointerleave`）不会吸附，按下就松手也不会。锁定状态下完全不吸附 —— 锁定
就是不建拖动状态，自然短路。吸附有 160ms 的 `left/top` 过渡，视觉上是滑过去而不是瞬移。

方块按钮位置与锁定状态存在浏览器 localStorage（键 `dshLuckyBlock.block`），换机器不跟。

## 出错了怎么看

方块头顶的气泡**只在报错时出现**（正常触发的进度、成功、会话 ID 都不写了 ——
有视觉表演的事件自己会演，没表演的由新会话内容承担反馈）。报错时气泡里是宿主
翻译过的**人话**，点一下可以关掉，例如：

| 情况 | 气泡说什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件本体没激活（改动 `lib/` 后没重启） | 插件没有注册这个接口，通常是插件本体未激活：重启 dsh 后再试 |
| 登录态过期 | 宿主拒绝了请求（未登录或登录已过期），刷新页面后重试 |
| 默认工作区被删/移走 | 默认工作区目录不存在或已被移动。请在 dsh 里重新确认默认工作区路径后再试 |
| 工作区不可写 | 没有权限写入工作区（被系统或沙箱拦下了） |
| `config.json` 里的模型不在目录里 | 模型不可用：config.json 里指定的 provider/model 不在可用目录中 |
| 都不是 | 意外错误：<宿主的原始信息> |

想看完整堆栈就翻宿主日志（`dsh` 标准输出）——那边始终打的是原始错误。

> 音效**不会**报错。拿不到音效文件、浏览器拦截自动播放、没有可用音频设备 ——
> 这些一律静默忽略。音效是锦上添花，为它弹一个红色报错气泡是本末倒置。

## 目录

- `lib/index.js` —— 宿主侧（Node）：选项注入、答案识别、回滚、幸运方块事件、默认工作区会话创建、可选模型切换、人格层与状态机、本地语料库分流、设置读写、音效文件投放、错误翻译。
- `lib/client.js` —— 客户端（浏览器）：可拖拽幸运方块按钮（含边缘吸附、锁定）+ 长按挖掘裂纹 / 碎裂粒子 / 音效 + 弹窗表演 + 蓝屏屏保 + 设置面板 + 台词气泡。
- `lib/persona.js` —— 随机事件的人格层（纯函数，可单测）：默认人格、覆盖合并、人格段拼装、任务正文保护、收尾点评请求。
- `lib/jokes.js` —— 本地笑话库加载器（读 `jokes-data.json`，带 BOM 剥离与只读一次缓存）。
- `lib/jokes-data.json` / `lib/trivia-data.json` —— 本地语料库。
- `lib/sounds/` —— 16 个原版 Minecraft 音效（`.ogg`，共 142 KB），由宿主按需投放。
- `cordis.patch.yml` —— 把宿主侧插件插进插件树（客户端那半由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client` 自动加载）。

## 素材出处

方块面与裂纹是原版 Minecraft 像素素材，以 base64 data URI 内联在 `lib/client.js` 里
（静态 bundle 的 `require()` 只认包 id、不认相对路径，所以不做成独立模块）：

| 素材 | 尺寸 | 来源 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 方块面 | 16×16 | `alexsocha/luckyblock` mod 的 `lucky_block.png` |
| 挖掘裂纹 10 帧 | 16×16 ×10 | 原版资源包 `PixiGeko/Minecraft-default-assets` 的 `assets/minecraft/textures/block/destroy_stage_0..9.png` |

裂纹用 `image-rendering: pixelated` 保持硬边，长按时按进度切到下一帧，最后一帧之后碎裂。
之所以找原素材而不是手绘：手绘的裂纹再怎么调都像程序生成的线条，和那张像素方块贴图
放在一起会突兀；换成原版的黑褐裂纹 + 白色反光碎屑，才是游戏里挖方块的样子。

音效是 Minecraft 1.20.1 原版 assets（`dig/stone1..4.ogg`、`random/break.ogg`），
经 `tools/build-sounds.mjs` 从 mcasset.cloud 镜像取到 `lib/sounds/`。版权归 Mojang Studios；
本插件只作本地开发期素材镜像，**运行时不依赖网络**。

人格的默认性格是照一款会说话的智能手枪塑造的（机器客服口吻、音量梗、人体数据冷知识）。
实现里刻意**不提任何作品名、角色名或制造商**：性格靠语气和句式传达，不靠名字。
`persona-check.mjs` 有多条断言盯着这一点。

开发期工具（`tools/`，安装运行不依赖）：
`host-smoke.mjs` 跑宿主侧回归（含音效路由与白名单）、
`persona-check.mjs` 人格层单测（真 import，62 条）、
`snap-check.mjs` 吸附纯函数（从 `client.js` 抽源码跑，不会与实现漂移）、
`config-check.mjs` 配置读取（含 BOM 坑）、
`local-check.mjs` 本地语料库与分流、
`verify-sounds.mjs` 音效文件 ↔ 客户端清单 ↔ 宿主白名单三方一致性、
`list-events.mjs` 打印事件清单与概率。

端到端探针（需要先起克隆 profile，流程见 `docs/探针流程.md`）：
`probe-sound.mjs`、`probe-settings.mjs`、`probe-visual-ids.mjs`、
`probe-persona.mjs`、`probe-flip.mjs`、`probe-flip-prompt.mjs`。

## 已知边界

- 回滚是「fork 到上一版本」：历史会话保留，新分支继续，不会删任何东西。
- 幸运方块开出来的会话不回滚（随机剧本被回滚会变得没意义）。
- 蓝屏屏保只盖 dsh 自己的窗口，不碰系统、不碰其他插件，60 秒或按 ESC 结束。
- 方块按钮用 pointer 事件实现长按，鼠标左键/触摸都行；键盘 Tab 聚焦后 Enter/Space 直接触发（跳过挖掘动画）。
- 挖掘裂纹用原版 `destroy_stage` 10 帧贴图（透明底），方块碎裂是纯 DOM 的一次白光闪 + 26 个像素碎片；都不受用户主题影响。

plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code 风格终端界面，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，兼容透明终端、VS Code 主题和自定义配色。
plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - plugins.description: Animated DeepSeek whale pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI - live status, completion chime, and an interaction + token/cost panel. No dependencies, no build step.
plugins.readme_text:
# 🐋 Whale pet

一个 DeepSeek 蓝色鲸鱼宠物插件,住在 Harness Web UI 右下角。

- **动效** — 空闲时轻轻浮动;工作时游动加快、气泡上升、光环脉动、外圈转动。
- **状态** — 实时显示 Harness 是否在工作,以及正在处理哪个会话。
- **音效** — 工作完成时播放 `assets/tone.wav`;失败时播放该音色的下行合成版本;开始工作时轻响一声。
- **用量与花费** — 点击鲸鱼展开面板,显示本会话的 token 分解(缓存命中 / 未命中 / 缓存写入 / 输出)、按官方费率算出的人民币(或美元)金额、会话时长、账户余额,以及每一次交互的明细。
- **交互记录** — 每条记录含提示词、回复摘要、工具 / 轮次 / 步骤计数、耗时与费用。

## 换音效

**完成音是一份文件,不是代码。** 直接替换即可:

```
plugin/assets/tone.wav
```

支持 `.wav` / `.mp3` / `.ogg` / `.m4a` / `.aac` / `.flac` / `.webm`(改名成 `tone.wav` 之外的扩展名后,同步改
`plugin/client.js` 里的 `TONE_URL` 常量)。

- 建议 **0.3–1.5 秒**、峰值接近但不超过 1.0,否则会被削波
- 改了资源要**重启 DSH**(主机端只在加载时读取一次,之后从内存提供)
- 若资源缺失或无法解码,**自动回退到合成音效**,不会静音

## 面板里的音色选择

下拉框的 5 个选项**播放的确实是不同的声音**:

| 选项 | 完成音来源 |
|---|---|
| **明亮铃音 Bright（音频文件）** | `assets/tone.wav` |
| 柔和木琴 Soft | 实时合成 |
| 木质马林巴 Marimba | 实时合成 |
| 轻点提示 Click | 实时合成 |
| 长尾钟声 Bell | 实时合成 |

每个音色用 `source` 字段声明完成音走哪条路:`'asset'` 播文件,`'synth'` 实时合成。
**失败与开始提示音始终是合成的**(资源里只有成功音),会跟随所选音色。

想只保留一种声音,把 `DEFAULT_TONE` 改成对应名字即可;其余选项仍留在下拉框里。

## 安装

需要 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2**(已验证版本)。

通过 Plugin Manager 安装,路径必须是**绝对路径**:

```
install_bundle  target: <绝对路径>/dsh-whale-pet/package
```

也支持 tarball(本地或 HTTP)与 git 仓库:

```
install_bundle  target: C:\path\to\dsh-whale-pet.tgz
install_bundle  target: https://example.com/dsh-whale-pet.tgz
```

`install_bundle` 会自己完成 profile 的包安装与 bundle 启用。**不要**手改 profile 的
`package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml`,也不要在 profile 目录里跑 pnpm。

## 启用与确认

- `Config.listConfigs name=dsh-whale-pet` → 应有一条 `include:pet-whale`
- `Slots.listSubTree root=shell.overlay` → 占用者 `pet-whale`,`active: true`
- `GET /pet-whale/state` → `{"ok":true,"version":3,…}`

## 改动后如何生效

| 改了什么 | 需要做什么 |
|---|---|
| `client.js`(界面) | 刷新页面(必要时 Ctrl+Shift+R 绕过缓存) |
| `index.js`(主机端) | **重启 DSH** |

原因:加载器每个进程世代只 import 一次 ES 模块,禁用/启用 bundle 只是复用缓存,
不会重新读取 `index.js`。

## 依赖情况

**没有任何运行时依赖,也没有 import。** 不需要 `node_modules`、不需要构建步骤:

- 主机端只用 Node 内置能力,不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包(这也是它能从裸
  `link:` 目录加载的原因)。
- 浏览器端是手写的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({...})` 格式,Web shell 本来就
  消费这种格式;React 从浏览器模块表里取。

安装方式决定了后续行为:

- 从**目录**安装 → profile 里建立 `link:`,指向你的文件夹,之后改动立即生效。
- 从 **tarball** 安装 → 复制一份,版本被冻结。**分发时用 tarball。**

## 运行环境要求

- profile 必须提供 `webServer`(随 Web 组合自带),否则面板拿不到数据。
- `deepseekAccount` 为可选:有它才显示账户余额;没有它其余功能照常,余额行不出现。
- 面板样式只使用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token,自动适配明暗主题。

## 说明

鲸鱼轮廓取自官方 Harness 品牌标的几何数据(`FISH_LOGO_PATH`),以便宠物与产品
视觉一致;该美术资源版权归 DeepSeek 所有,本包不主张任何权利。详见 `LICENSE`。

完整的设计说明、实现取舍与验证方式见仓库根目录的 `DESIGN.md`。

plugins.description: Agnes image & video generation for DeepSeek Harness: two agent tools, an AI prompt optimizer and a sidebar panel — poster-first cards, honest progress. No API key shipped. / DSH 的 Agnes 图像与视频生成插件：两个 Agent 工具、AI 提示词优化器与侧边栏面板；封面优先卡片、诚实进度条；不含任何密钥。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agnes-image

**English** · [中文](README_ZH.md)

Agnes image and video generation for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-harness). It adds two agent tools (`agnes_generate_image`, `agnes_generate_video`), an AI prompt optimizer, and a sidebar panel with four tabs: Images, Videos, Library, Settings. Progress reporting is honest, cards are poster-first, and files are handed off to the desktop.

The plugin ships without an API key. Install it, open the panel's Settings tab, paste your Agnes key once and save. Only then do the generation buttons light up; until then they are disabled and explain why. Credentials live in your own `%DSH_HOME%` data directory, never in this repository.

Both halves are hand-written against the official DSH bundle format. There is no build step: `index.js` is the host half, and `client.js` is the browser bundle.

Agnes APIs used:

| Purpose | Model | Endpoint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Image generation | `agnes-image-2.5-flash` | `POST https://api.agnes-ai.cn/v1/images/generations` |
| Video generation | `agnes-video-2.5-flash` (default; 720P only) | `POST https://api.agnes-ai.cn/v1/videos`, poll `GET https://api.agnes-ai.cn/agnesapi?video_id=&model_name=` |
| Prompt optimization | `agnes-3.0-flash` | `POST https://api.agnes-ai.cn/v1/chat/completions` |

Docs: [image](https://www.agnes-ai.cn/zh-Hans/docs/agnes-image-25-flash) · [video](https://www.agnes-ai.cn/zh-Hans/docs/agnes-video-25-flash) · [text](https://www.agnes-ai.cn/zh-Hans/docs/agnes-30-flash)

## Screenshots

Real panel in a desktop profile, captured from the running harness.

| Images tab | Videos tab |
| --- | --- |
| ![Images tab](screenshots/panel-images.png) | ![Videos tab](screenshots/panel-video.png) |

| Image library | Video library, posters |
| --- | --- |
| ![Image library](screenshots/library-images.png) | ![Video library](screenshots/library-videos.png) |

![Settings tab](screenshots/panel-settings.png)

## Files

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | bundle manifest: `dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client` (platform `web`) + `exports["./client"]` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch layer. One `insert` row with `id: agnes-image`, which is also the settings namespace. No credential is written here. |
| `index.js` | host half: Config, key resolution (panel only), Agnes calls, disk output, tool registration, `/api/agnes-image/*` routes (video, video covers, prompt optimize, local file open) |
| `client.js` | browser half: `sidebar.panellist` icon plus the whole `main` page (Images / Videos / Library / Settings) |
| `icon.svg` | sidebar icon |

## Documentation

Longer notes live in `docs/`:

- [Index](docs/index.en.md)
- [Install](docs/install.en.md) · [Usage](docs/usage.en.md) · [Configuration](docs/configuration.en.md) · [Architecture](docs/architecture.en.md) · [Contributing](docs/contributing.en.md)
- 中文版：[docs/index.md](docs/index.md) · [README_ZH.md](README_ZH.md)

## Capabilities

### 1. Agent tool `agnes_generate_image`

Call it straight from a conversation.

Parameters: `prompt` (required), `size` (`1K`/`2K`/`3K`/`4K`), `ratio` (`1:1`, `3:4`, `4:3`, `16:9`, `9:16`, `2:3`, `3:2`, `21:9`), `count` (1–4), `reference_images` (image-to-image or composition: a public HTTPS URL or a `data:image/...;base64` string).

It returns absolute paths on disk, for example:

```
Agnes generated 1 image (agnes-image-2.5-flash, 2K 1:1).
Saved to disk — absolute paths:
  C:\...\default-workspace\agnes-images\2026-10-16\190212-测试：一只戴宇航头盔的柴犬.png  (836.9 KB)
```

### 2. Agent tool `agnes_generate_video`

This one blocks: create task, poll, download. The default ceiling is 15 minutes.

Parameters: `prompt` (required), `mode` (`text` / `keyframe` / `reference`), `seconds` (`"4"`–`"12"`, default `"5"`), `size` (`720P`; with `agnes-video-2.5` also `1080P`/`1K`/`2K`), `aspect_ratio` (`16:9`/`9:16`/`1:1`/`4:3`/`3:4`/`21:9`), `first_frame` / `last_frame` (keyframe mode), `images[]` / `audios[]` (reference mode), `seed`.

Agnes enforces the per-mode media rules, and this plugin validates them locally before the request, then re-throws the upstream error verbatim. `text` carries no media. `keyframe` needs at least one frame and no images or audios. `reference` needs at least one image or audio clip and no first or last frame. In `reference` mode local file paths are inlined into `data:` URLs automatically: single file under 15 MB, edge length 256–5760 px, and anything outside that errors. Public HTTPS URLs are accepted too.

### 3. AI prompt optimizer

Both prompt boxes, image and video, have an AI Optimize button. It hands the current prompt to a language model and shows a rewrite card first. The card holds only the rewritten prompt, expanded in place right under the prompt box and above the button. The original stays in the input above, the card does not repeat it, and it has no card title. Adopt writes it back, Discard throws it away, Retry asks again. The rewrite keeps subject and intent and only adds visual detail: composition, light, palette, material, mood, style. It follows the input language. The video side additionally asks for motion, camera movement and pacing.

Two backends, picked from a dropdown and persisted to settings:

| Backend | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `agnes` (default) | `agnes-3.0-flash` via Agnes Chat Completions, same key as generation |
| `dsh` | Reuses the harness' current conversation model (`agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()`). If the host has no LLM service or the profile has no model configured, the option shows as unavailable and nothing else is affected |

### 4. Sidebar panel

Four tabs, left to right: Images, Videos, Library, Settings. The panel shares the same host code path as the tools, so behavior is identical.

- Images: prompt, size, ratio, count, optional reference images. Thumbnails appear immediately.
- Videos: prompt, mode, seconds, aspect ratio, resolution. Keyframe mode reveals first/last frame inputs, reference mode reveals image and audio rows. After submit the button area shows queue and render progress and polls automatically. On completion it never plays in the panel; it shows a poster plus "Open with default app". History is not on this tab. Everything is collected in the Library.
- Progress bar: a running image job shows an indeterminate striped bar plus elapsed seconds. Image generation is a single call with no percentage, so no number is invented. A running video job shows the real upstream percentage (0/10/70/100), plus status and elapsed seconds, for example `Rendering: in_progress · 10% · 84s elapsed`. When the upstream percentage has not moved for more than 12 seconds, which is very common because the 10% step alone can sit for two minutes, the bar switches from a fill to flowing stripes and the caption becomes `Upstream still reports 10% — rendering · 132s elapsed`. It says where the number comes from instead of faking motion or inventing digits, and snaps back to a real fill the moment upstream jumps to 70 or 100. The bar occupies the slot where the old status card was.
- Library: a segmented switch at the top toggles Image library and Video library. Each has its own count and refresh button. Both render as small card grids, about 116 px per image column and 182 px per video column. Videos show a poster only and never play here.
- Cards carry a thumbnail by default. Collapsed, a card shows a thumbnail on top and the file name below, 96×96 for images and 160×90 for video posters. Clicking the file name or the chevron expands the card to reveal the prompt, size, ratio, duration, bytes and the action buttons. Hovering the thumbnail scales it slightly, 1.03×, and draws an orange ring as a hint that it can be double-clicked.
- Opening local files: double-click the thumbnail or poster, or use "Open with default app" in the expanded area. The file goes to the desktop's default association, images to the image viewer and videos to the default player, which is semantically the same as double-clicking in Explorer. "Reveal in folder" selects the file instead. The expand button and the file name only toggle expansion; they never open files.
- Settings: API key (saved into the plugin data

plugins.description: 在 DSH 对话窗的「对话 / 轨迹」之外再加一个「交付文件」视图：汇总当前会话里全部显式交付（present）与文件产出（write / edit），一个会话一份可检索的文件库。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-delivery-library

在 DSH 对话窗的 **对话 / 轨迹** 两个页签之外，再加一个 **交付文件** 页签：把当前会话里
**全部显式交付**（`present`）和**全部文件产出**（`write` / `edit`）汇总成一份可检索的
文件库，一个会话一份，不用再往回翻聊天记录。

- **纯插件**：不改 DSH 本体，只往 `conversation.view` 座位追加一个新 id 的格子。
- **不读磁盘**：清单完全由当前会话**已载入的事件窗口**折叠而来，不新增宿主路由、
  不扫工作区、不碰会话日志文件。
- **两栏分开**：`交付` 只看模型显式声明的最终文件；`产出` 看 write / edit 真正写出的
  文件。两者不混。

## 快速安装

在 DSH 的「**设置 → 插件**」安装入口填：

```
github:BlankTasftu/dsh-delivery-library
```

装好后页签变成 `对话 | 轨迹 | 交付文件`；想确认装到的是完整件，直接在安装目录里跑
`node --test "test/*.test.mjs"`（零依赖，期望 60/60）。细节见 [安装](#安装)。

## 它长什么样

对话窗顶部页签从 `对话 | 轨迹` 变成 `对话 | 轨迹 | 交付文件`。点进去：

```
┌ 交付文件库            本会话：交付 3 · 产出 12 ────────────┐
│ [ 交付 3 ] [ 产出 12 ]        [ 搜索文件名、路径或说明 ]   │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ┌MD┐ 调研报告.md                    第 4 轮  ×2   [复制路径]│
│ │  │ 最终版，含结论与附录                                   │
│ │  │ out/reports                                           │
│ ┌PNG┐ chart.png                      第 4 轮              │
│ │   │ assets                                              │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 交付 = present 声明 · 产出 = write / edit 成功写出         │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- **点一行** → 在右侧栏预览该文件（走 `dsh-resource://file/session/<会话>/<路径>`）。
  没装右栏时自动退化成"复制路径"，点击不会变成没反应。
- **复制路径**按钮：悬停行时出现，不会连带打开预览。
- **搜索**：同时匹配文件名、目录、说明。
- **×N**：同一个文件被多次交付；说明取**最近一次**，轮次取**首次**进库那一轮。
- 会话很长、更早的历史还没载入时，底部出现 **加载更早**（走 `session.loadOlder()`）。

## 安装

### 给别人装（从 GitHub）

在 DSH 的「**设置 → 插件**」里用安装入口填这个安装说明符：

```
github:BlankTasftu/dsh-delivery-library
```

它和 `dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:BlankTasftu/dsh-delivery-library` 是同一个
安装说明符（桌面端不自带 `dsh` 命令行，所以多数人走设置页）。插件管理器会把它写进
profile 的依赖与 bundles 清单，再交给 pnpm 安装 —— 与 `dsh-ark`、`dsh-media-preview`
那类插件的安装方式完全一致。

**无需刷新即可生效**：宿主会把新的启动图经 `/plugins/events`（SSE）推给已打开的页面，
页面随即物化并挂上这个条目。页签没出现时再按一次 F5。

装好后想确认拿到的是不是完整件，可以直接在安装目录里跑自带测试（**零依赖，不需要装任何东西**）：

```powershell
node --test "test/*.test.mjs"     # 期望 60/60
```

### 本机开发（软链到工作区）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:D:\DeepSeekSpace\插件
```

等价的等价手工做法：在 `%DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop\package.json` 里加

```jsonc
"dependencies": { "dsh-delivery-library": "link:D:/DeepSeekSpace/插件" },
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* … */, "dsh-delivery-library" ] } }
```

然后在该目录跑 `pnpm install`。软链的好处是改完 `lib/client.js` 刷新页面即生效。

⚠️ **给改这个插件的人（也包括未来的我）**：客户端插件的 `apply` 里**任何未捕获异常
都会让桌面端直接退出** —— 渲染进程的启动审计会把未达 `active` 的条目上报为
`web boot: N entry did not activate`，桌面主进程把它当致命错误。
所以本插件的 `apply` 被刻意写成**整体不可抛**（每步单独 try/catch），失败只降级、
并把面包屑写进 `shell.overlay` 的诊断条目。详见 [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md#5-事故记录一次把桌面端打崩的-apply-抛错010--020)。

### 装完/出问题时自查（只读探针，随包一起交付）

```powershell
node tools/check-host-resolution.mjs   # 从 profile 出发能否解析到 browser bundle
node tools/check-boot-graph.mjs        # 插件在不在启动图、在哪个批次、批次能否投递
node tools/check-profile-patch.mjs     # profile 的 patch 层 YAML 是否完好、关键条目是否还在
```

地址/路径都可覆盖：`DSH_PROFILE_DIR`、`DSH_WEB_URL`、`DSH_ASAR_PATH`（见
[tools/paths.mjs](tools/paths.mjs)）。

崩溃日志（如果哪天又崩了，先看这里）：

```
%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\logs\crash-*-web-boot.log
```

卸载：设置 → 插件里停用或卸载该 bundle；或从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉包名再 `pnpm install`。

## 数据口径（哪些文件会出现在这里）

| 栏位 | 来源 | 判据 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 交付 | 会话事件 `deliverables/presented` | `present` 工具**成功**执行后由宿主 append，形如 `{ turn, callId, files: [{ path, description? }] }` |
| 产出 | 会话事件 `tool/call` + `tool/result` | 只认 `write`、`edit`、以及完整改写的 `str_replace_editor`；且**结果必须不是错误** |

也就是说：读文件、删除、失败或被中断的调用、参数残缺的调用，都不会进清单；
用终端命令（`pwsh`/`bash`）创建的文件也不会出现在「产出」里 —— 只有模型显式
`present` 才会进「交付」。这与出厂 `ui-deliverables` 的卡片口径一致。

同一路径按**归一化形状**（反斜杠、`./` 前缀、尾斜杠）合并为一行，**不折叠大小写**：
大小写敏感的文件系统上 `A.md` 与 `a.md` 是两个文件，猜错会把两份交付合成一行。

## 活动边界（这个插件只做插件该做的事）

这一条不是口头保证，而是 **`test/isolation.test.mjs` 里 10 个静态断言**钉住的：

| 面 | 结论 | 断言 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 宿主半侧 | **什么都不做**：没有任何 `import`／`require`，不引用 `fs`/`child_process`/`net`/`http`/`process`/`eval`，`apply()` 是空函数 | 4 条 |
| 浏览器半侧 | 只 `require('react')`；不联网（无 fetch/XHR/WebSocket/EventSource）；不写任何存储（localStorage/sessionStorage/indexedDB/cookie）；无 `eval`；不碰文件（文件只拼一个 `dsh-resource://` 地址交给侧栏读） | 4 条 |
| 装载声明 | `cordis.patch.yml` **只插入自己这一行**，不含 `disabled`／`inject`／其它条目的覆盖；package.json 无安装脚本、无任何依赖、无可执行入口 | 2 条 |

运行时它到底动了什么：**注入一份带 `data-plugin` 标记的 `<style>`**（插件卸载时由宿主按标记回收）
＋ 在 `conversation.view` 座位注册一个格子 ＋ 注册两份词典。仅此而已。

> 安装动作本身（`dsh plugin add` / 插件管理器 / pnpm）会在 profile 目录里写
> `package.json` 的一条依赖与 bundles 名单，并建一个指向本目录的链接 —— 那是**安装器**
> 的写入，不是插件运行时行为；本插件在运行时对 profile、DSH 本体、系统都零写入。

## 已知边界

- 清单覆盖**已载入**的会话事件窗口。会话非常长时窗口可能只含尾部，底部会给
  「加载更早」；点它即向前补页，补进来的交付会立刻出现在清单里。
- 视图是**会话作用域**的：切换会话就换一份清单；空会话不渲染视图区（与出厂行为一致）。
- 交付卡片打开的是**当前文件**，不是交付那一刻的快照；文件被删掉后预览会报找不到。
- 不提供"在资源管理器中显示"：那需要宿主 desktop 路由与授权坐标，超出本插件范围。
- 路径原样使用会话记录里的拼写（含 `..`），与出厂 `ui-deliverables` 的资源地址判据完全一致
  —— 打开与否最终由宿主的会话文件服务裁决，插件不做也不该做路径改写。
- 极端长的会话（几百个产出文件）列表会一次性渲染，没有虚拟滚动；搜索框是主要的收敛手段。

## 开发

```
lib/index.js                    宿主半侧：空实现（只作为客户端 bundle 的装载入口）
lib/client.js                   浏览器半侧：视图 + 事件折叠（全部功能在这里）
test/                           60 个用例：折叠逻辑 / 注册契约 / 崩溃防护 / 样式选择器 /
                                渲染冒烟 / 隔离性 / 清单一致性
tools/asar-extract.mjs          只读：从 app.asar 抽取内置包源码（核对契约用）
tools/asar-ls.mjs               只读：列 asar 内某个目录
tools/check-boot-graph.mjs      只读：本插件在不在启动图、在哪个批次、批次可投递
tools/check-host-resolution.mjs 只读：从 profile 出发能否解析到 browser bundle
tools/check-profile-patch.mjs   只读：profile patch 的 YAML 是否完好、关键条目还在不在
tools/paths.mjs                 上面几个探针共享的路径解析（走环境变量，不写死机器路径）
docs/DESIGN.md                  为什么这样取数、座位契约、验证证据、事故记录
docs/RECOVERY-profile-config.md 故障档案：新会话报 no API key 的那次配置丢失
```

跑测试（不需要安装任何依赖）：

```powershell
$NODE = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe"
& $NODE --test "test/*.test.mjs"
```

`test/harness.mjs` 会按 DSH 的真实装载契约（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load` + `factory(require)`）
执行**要发货的那份 `lib/client.js`**，再用一个迷你 React 运行时把它渲染出来 ——
测的不是副本，也没有引入测试框架依赖。

## 版本

- `0.2.0` —— 修复 0.1.0 里一个会让 DSH 桌面端退出的选择器缺陷；`apply` 改为绝不抛错并带诊断通道；
  见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) 与 [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md) 第 5 节。

MIT · 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Plan / Build mode switcher for DeepSeek Harness: a composer dropdown plus a default-mode setting for new sessions.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plan-build-mode

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A **Plan / Build** mode switcher for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`), shaped like opencode's Build/Plan selector.

Two things it adds:

1. **A dropdown in the composer**, sitting immediately to the right of the permission control (`完全权限` / `Full access`). It is always visible and switches the **current** session both ways.
2. **A "Default mode" row in Settings → General**, directly under the permission row. It decides which mode **newly created** sessions start in.

## Why it exists

DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 already ships Plan mode (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode`), but the official composer chip `PlanChip` is **exit-only**:

```js
if (!(plan.pending ? !plan.active : plan.active)) return null;
```

When the session is not in Plan mode the chip renders nothing at all, so **the only way into Plan mode is typing `/plan` by hand** — there is no discoverable entry point. This plugin takes the same seat (`conversation.input.plan`) and supplies a two-way dropdown instead.

## Features

- **Always-visible dropdown** showing the current mode (`Build` or `Plan`) with a chevron.
- **Two menu items with a check mark**:
  - **Build** — implement directly (`/plan off`)
  - **Plan** — plan only, no changes executed (`/plan`)
- **Blue highlight** while in Plan mode (uses the official `--dsw-alias-state-business-*` tokens).
- **Optimistic display** — while a switch is in flight (`pending`), the button already shows the target mode.
- **Default mode row** — pick `Build` / `Plan` as the starting mode for new sessions. The current session is unaffected; use the composer control for that.

## Install

Pin the version, so pnpm's release cooldown cannot hand you an older build:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plan-build-mode@1.1.0
```

Straight from GitHub (no npm publish needed):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:yzhclcl/dsh-plan-build-mode
```

Desktop app: install from the in-app **Plugins** page. The CLI cannot modify `profiles/desktop`.

Then **fully quit and restart** the process serving the profile. The client bundle revision is derived from file metadata (`mtime`/`ctime`/`size`), so a page refresh alone is not enough — a stale revision makes the browser request a URL the server now 404s, which surfaces as `client-modules: bundle script ... failed to load`.

## Use

**Composer dropdown** — click it, pick `Build` or `Plan`. It maps to the shipped `/plan` and `/plan off` commands, so nothing about the plan-mode machinery changes.

**Default mode** — Settings → General → *Default mode*, under the permission row.

> **Note**: the first time you save this row, `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` gains a top-level entry at the end:
>
> ```yaml
> - id: plan-build-mode
>   name: dsh-plan-build-mode
>   config:
>     defaultMode: plan
>   ```
>
> That is the normal `config-editor` write path. Delete the entry (or set `build`) to go back to the default.

## How it works

| Concern | Approach |
| --- | --- |
| Composer seat | `conversation.input.plan` — the `modes` row of the input bar, adjacent to `conversation.input.permission` |
| Shadowing the official chip | `register({ priority: -1 })` — a `single` slot only rejects *equal* priority; the lowest priority renders |
| Reading state | `useProjection("plan")` → `{ active, pending }` |
| Switching | `ctx.remote.commands.execute(sessionId, "/plan" \| "/plan off", [])` |
| Styles | deduplicated injection via `style[data-plugin-css="dsh-plan-build-mode"]`, reusing official size/colour tokens |
| Settings row seat | `settings.general.item` list slot, `id: "default-mode"`, `order: -10` (permission is `-20`, language is `0`) |
| Settings read/write | `ctx.configForms.get("plan-build-mode")` → `remote.settings.mutate(ns, [{op:"set",path:["defaultMode"],value}], revision)` |
| Config field | `z.union([z.const("build"), z.const("plan")]).default("build").volatile()` — only entries carrying volatile fields reach the settings surface |
| Suppressing the auto form | `ctx.inject(["settings"], (child) => child.effect(() => child.settings.configure({ auto: false }, ctx.fiber)))` |
| Pinning new sessions | On `session/created`, if the session is brand new (`seq === 0`, not seeded, no `parentSession`) and the default is `plan`, append `plan/mode` `{ active: true }` — the same first-party event `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode` writes, and one of the names on the persisted event allowlist |

### What "Plan mode" actually is

Plan mode is a **soft, prompt-level** guide, not a sandbox. All tools stay available in both modes; the harness injects a `plan:policy` prompt section that tells the model to explore and plan rather than execute. Real restriction comes from the **permission presets** (sandbox mode + approval policy), which are independent and read no plan state. If you want a hard read-only guarantee, switch the permission preset to Read Only.

Switching mid-turn is supported: the intent is queued and applied at the next turn boundary, while the button immediately reflects the target.

## Compatibility

| dsh | Status |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | Verified on Windows, web profile — dropdown, settings row, persistence, and new-session pinning all exercised |

Declared range: `>=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0-0`. The plugin targets the 0.2.x seat layout (`conversation.input.plan`, `settings.general.item`) and the `plan/mode` event, so older 0.1.x hosts are out of scope.

## Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plan-build-mode
```

Restart afterwards. The official `PlanChip` returns to its original behaviour immediately — **this plugin modifies no official file**.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show a running / just-finished indicator on sidebar workspace rows
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-activity

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Marks each workspace in the sidebar while one of its sessions is running.

A session row already shows a spinner while it runs. This plugin puts the same
spinner on the **workspace row above it**, so a collapsed or scrolled workspace
list still tells you which project is busy without expanding anything.

```
📁 dsh-workspace                    ◌      ← added by this plugin
   ◌ 处理所有 skill 同步到已同步      刚刚
```

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-workspace-activity
```

Restart dsh, or reload the page. The plugin is a bundle, so it also works
through the plugin market and any other bundle-aware client.

## What it does

The sidebar shows no indicator on a workspace row today. The plugin derives one
from the same status feed the session rows use, so the two agree:

- A workspace is marked when at least one of its sessions is running.
- Subagent sessions are skipped. The sidebar folds them into their parent's row
  and never draws one of its own, and their ids belong to no workspace, so a mark
  from one would have no row to sit on.
- Sessions the sidebar hides as archived are skipped. This matches the default
  view. The sidebar's archive filter can also show archived sessions, and the
  plugin cannot see which setting is active — it is not part of what
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` exposes — so with the filter set to show
  archived sessions, a running archived row can appear under an unmarked
  workspace.
- The status feed is authoritative; the session list is the fallback, matching
  the precedence the workspace browser itself uses.
- The mark is a spinner at the row's trailing edge, in the same 16px slot the
  session rows use for their timestamps, drawn with the product's own theme
  token and stroke geometry.
- A **collapsed** workspace also tints its folder glyph with the same blue the
  browser paints on the group you are inside. Collapsed rows hide their
  sessions, so the glyph has to carry the state alone; an expanded row already
  shows its sessions and keeps the browser's own colouring.
- Readers who cannot see it get the count and the workspace names through a
  visually hidden description.

## How it works

A workspace row declares no slot, so there is no supported place to render into.
The plugin instead contributes a stylesheet that decorates the row the sidebar
already renders. It writes nothing to the document, observes nothing, and appends
no nodes: the rule targets the row's trailing pseudo-element and React keeps
owning the row.

This is the one thing to know before installing it: **the rule targets the
sidebar's `data-row-key` attribute**, which is an internal detail of
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` rather than a published contract. If a
future release renames it, the spinner stops appearing until the plugin is
updated. Nothing else breaks — the plugin never mutates the DOM, so a stale
selector degrades to "no indicator", not to a broken sidebar.

## Requirements

- A Web (or desktop) client — this is a client-only plugin, `dsh.client.platform: web`.
- No host services, no configuration, no permissions.

## Development

Written in TypeScript; `src/` is the source of truth and `lib/` is generated
(and committed — see below). The scripts under `scripts/` are TypeScript too and
run straight through Node's type stripping, which needs Node 22.18 or newer; no
separate runner is involved.

```sh
npm install
npm run build     # tsdown -> lib/, then wraps the Client half in the module envelope
npm run check     # typecheck + lint + format check + build + verify
```

| Script                    | What it does                                                     |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `build`                   | Emits `lib/index.js` and `lib/client.js`.                        |
| `verify`                  | Loads the built Client half and renders it with a real renderer. |
| `typecheck`               | `tsc --noEmit`.                                                  |
| `lint` / `lint:fix`       | Oxlint, type-aware, with the React hooks rules.                  |
| `format` / `format:check` | Prettier.                                                        |
| `check`                   | Everything above, in the order CI would run it.                  |

`build` runs `scripts/wrap-client.ts` after tsdown: the Client half has to
reach the browser as a `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` call
whose `id` is the package name, and the wrapper supplies that envelope.

`lib/` is committed on purpose, and this package deliberately declares no
lifecycle script. pnpm refuses to install a git-hosted package that has one
unless the consumer allowlists it, which would make the plugin uninstallable
straight from the repository; with no script to run, `add` simply consumes the
committed output. Run `npm run build` after changing `src/`.

`verify` is not a mock of the sidebar. It captures the factory the envelope
registers, drives `apply` against a stub context, and renders the registered
component with `react-test-renderer` — enough to prove the envelope, the
registration, and the stylesheet the entry publishes. The running sidebar is
still the only place the indicator's position and colour can be judged.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: An unofficial whale-girl companion for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar brand mark plus a draggable, collapsible floating mascot with live token usage.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-whale-girl

An unofficial **whale-girl (鲸鱼娘) companion** for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
She replaces the sidebar brand mark and floats over the page as a draggable,
collapsible mascot: her head follows your cursor, she reacts to pats and clicks,
she follows what the agent is doing, and her speech bubble reports the current
session's real token usage.

![whale-girl](assets/whale-girl-768.webp)

> The character is community fan art, not an official DeepSeek asset — see
> [Source & attribution](#source--attribution). Chinese docs: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md).

## What she does

| Area | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Sidebar brand mark (`sidebar.brand.mark`) | Replaces the stock fish logo with a close-up of her face (`avatar-face.png`). Registered with `priority: -1` so it wins the single-value slot. |
| Floating companion (`shell.overlay`) | A 220×298 paper doll over the frame, with a token card above her and speech bubbles. Drag her anywhere inside the frame (position kept in `localStorage['whale-girl:position']`); double-click returns her to the bottom-right corner and forgets the position; when the window shrinks she is folded back into view. |
| Gaze | Her head turns towards the pointer (up to ±7°) and her tail counter-swings (±4.8°); both settle back to centre 0.22 s after the pointer leaves. The pivot is measured from the eyes/lashes in the art, not from the bounding box. |
| Pat | Press and hold ≥ 350 ms: a one-shot squash-and-return animation plus a dedicated line. She does **not** fold away. |
| Click and combo | A quick click (< 350 ms) folds or unfolds her, with an answering line; 3–4 fast clicks get a counted complaint; the 5th click fires a one-shot easter egg. |
| Mood | `data-mood` follows context occupancy: `<50%` `calm`, `≥50%` `tense`, `≥85%` `crit`. Each crossing drops a 💦 in her corner for 2.6 s. |
| Speech | Lines are triggered by state and filled with real numbers from DSH's own session projections (`tokenUsage`, `contextPressure`): a greeting on mount, an answer on click, live progress while the turn is producing output, a context warning at 80 %, and a "done" line 2.5 s after output stops. She never calls the network or the model. |
| Token card | Context occupancy (bar plus `tokens / window`) and output / input / cache-read counts for the current session — the same projections the composer's own indicator uses. Hidden when there is no session; it yields when the window is narrower than 900 px. |
| Three-layer puppet | Her body, head and tail are separate layers that are pixel-identical to the still illustration at rest, so they are invisible until she moves. |

Animations run only while she is being interacted with: exactly three one-shot
`@keyframes` (`wg-pat` / `wg-egg` / `wg-emote`), no `infinite`, no `alternate`,
no `will-change`; `getAnimations()` is empty when idle.

## Install

The package declares a `dsh.bundle` patch, so installing it mounts both halves —
no profile editing, no manual copy:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Turanbuturan/dsh-agent-whale-girl
```

`--profile desktop` is the DSH desktop app; use `--profile web` for a plain web
profile. A release tarball or a local checkout works the same way:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-agent-whale-girl
```

Reload the page afterwards. Host-side changes need a full app restart (Node's ESM
cache pins the module path), but this plugin's host half is empty — a page
refresh is enough.

### Manual drop-in

Copy the folder into `<profile>/plugins/` and add the row to the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: whale-girl
      name: "./plugins/dsh-agent-whale-girl/index.js"
```

The path resolves against the profile directory. Removing the `insert` row (and
refreshing) removes her; the folder may stay in place.

### Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-agent-whale-girl
```

If you used the manual drop-in instead, delete the `insert` row and refresh.

## Build and verify

`lib/client.js` and `lib/client.css` are committed, so installing needs no build
step. To rebuild after changing the art or the skeleton:

```sh
node build.mjs            # regenerates lib/client.js + lib/client.css from the PNGs and layers.json
node verify-bundle.cjs lib/client.js
```

`verify-bundle.cjs` is a structural and behavioural self-check (registrations,
injected CSS, layer geometry, gaze maths, click/pat/combo timing, mood values).
Use absolute paths — the script resolves the bundle relative to the working
directory.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | Declares `dsh.bundle.patch` (installable bundle) and `dsh.client.platform = "web"` (browser half). |
| `index.js` | Host half: an intentionally empty `apply()` so the loader can mount the package. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The mount declaration read at install time. |
| `lib/client.js` / `lib/client.css` | Build output: the client bundle that registers both slots, and the stylesheet it injects. |
| `build.mjs` | Builds the two files above from the PNGs and `layers.json` (inlines the art, writes the skeleton geometry into CSS). |
| `layers.json` | Puppet skeleton: crop boxes, rotation origins in the 414×560 art space, amplitudes, measured pivots. |
| `verify-bundle.cjs` | Self-check. |
| `avatar-body.png` / `avatar-head.png` / `avatar-tail.png` | The three puppet layers. |
| `avatar-face.png` | 96×96 face crop used by the 24 px mark and the folded bubble. |
| `avatar.png` | The full-body illustration before cutting. |
| `assets/` | Source art. |

## Source & attribution

The code is MIT. The character art is community fan art and keeps the terms of
the repositories it came from:

- [`Neko3000/deepseek-whalechan`](https://github.com/Neko3000/deepseek-whalechan) — MIT — **the art used now**; cut into layers and background-removed here.
- [`TreapGoGo/deepseek-whale-girl`](https://github.com/TreapGoGo/deepseek-whale-girl) — MIT — the earlier chibi avatar (`assets/whale-girl-avatar-512.png`).
- [`fornarwhal/deepseek-whale-girl-icon`](https://github.com/fornarwhal/deepseek-whale-girl-icon) — custom terms — reviewed as a candidate icon source, not shipped.

See [NOTICE](NOTICE) for the file-by-file mapping. "DeepSeek" and the DeepSeek
whale logo belong to their respective owners; this plugin is an unofficial
community project.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: 发布尺寸检查：对照目标平台规格，检查图片能不能发、哪一项参数过不了。零依赖、只查几何参数，含 dpi 达标≠可用与多图一致性检查。
plugins.readme_text:
# publish-size-check

[![CI](https://github.com/Stephen-pc/publish-size-check/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Stephen-pc/publish-size-check/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Python 3.8+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.8%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/downloads/)
[![Zero dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-brightgreen.svg)](#为什么需要它)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

> 发布尺寸检查 —— 对照目标平台的几何规格，告诉你这张图**能不能发、是哪一项过不了**。

零依赖（纯标准库，不需要 Pillow）、原件只读、结果确定。

```console
$ python scripts/spec.py --check cover.png --target 小红书

### cover.png
    1024×1024px · 0.6MB · 无损

    [X]  小红书 / 笔记封面（方版） —— 不能发布
         结论: 救不了：像素不足，必须从源文件按更大尺寸重新导出（放大无效）
         [X] 宽度 1024px 小于要求 1080px
             修法: 重新导出为 ≥1080px 宽（放大现有图片无法恢复清晰度）
```

---

## 为什么需要它

**AI 出图的默认尺寸，基本都过不了主流平台。**

实测三种最常见的 AI 出图尺寸投小红书封面：

| 产出尺寸 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 1024×1024 | ✗ 宽度差 56px |
| 1024×1536 | ✗ 宽度不足 + 比例不对 |
| 1536×1024 | ✗ 比例完全不对 |

这不是边界情况，是**主流工作流的默认产出**。而平台的报错往往只说"图片不符合要求"，不告诉你差多少、差在哪一项。

更隐蔽的一类：**dpi 字段达标，但实际印不出来**。

一张 `800×600 @300dpi` 的图，dpi 元数据完全合格，但按 300dpi 印出来只有 **68mm 宽**，达不到期刊单栏 88mm 的要求。**改 dpi 数字不会增加一个像素**——这类图必须从源文件重新导出。多数工具只比 dpi 数值，会直接放行。

本工具按 `像素数 ÷ dpi × 25.4 = 实际印刷宽度(mm)` 判定，能抓出这一类。

---

## 快速开始

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Stephen-pc/publish-size-check.git
cd publish-size-check

# 一键看效果：跑五种典型场景，自动清理临时文件
python demo.py

# 体检一个文件（指定平台）
python scripts/spec.py --check cover.png --target 小红书

# 先看看某平台到底要什么
python scripts/spec.py --spec 小红书

# 不确定发哪，扫全部社媒平台
python scripts/spec.py --check cover.png

# 多图连发（≥2 个文件会自动追加「整组是否整齐」检查）
python scripts/spec.py --check 1.png 2.png 3.png --target 小红书

# 程序化消费
python scripts/spec.py --check cover.png --target 小红书 --json

# 列出规格库收录的平台
python scripts/spec.py --list
```

需要 Python 3.8+，**不需要安装任何第三方包**。

### 也可以当命令行工具装

```bash
pip install .
publish-size-check --check cover.png --target 小红书
```

装完后规格库会随包一起装好，路径自动定位；也可以用环境变量 `PUBLISH_SIZE_CHECK_SPEC` 指定自己的规格库。

---

## 支持的平台

| 平台 | 槽位 | 可信度 |
|---|---|---|
| 微信公众号 | 头条封面 / 次条封面 / 正文配图 | 已交叉印证 |
| 小红书 | 笔记封面（竖版）/ 笔记封面（方版）/ 笔记内页 | 已交叉印证 |
| 哔哩哔哩 | 视频封面 | 已交叉印证 |
| 知乎 | 回答/想法配图 / 文章封面 | 社区共识 |
| 微博 | 博文配图 / 头条文章头图 | 社区共识 |
| 抖音 | 视频封面（9:16）/ 图文封面（3:4） | 社区共识 |
| 微信视频号 | 视频封面 / 视频画面 | 社区共识 |
| 学术投稿 | 连续色调图 / 线条图 | 社区共识 |
| 印刷交付 | 胶印数码印刷 / 大幅喷绘 | 社区共识 |
| 甲方交付 | 可编辑源文件 | 经验值 |

共 **10 个平台 / 20 个槽位 / 46 个可解析名称**。平台参数支持 id、中文名、别名，模糊匹配也能命中（`红书` → 小红书、`投个稿` → 学术投稿）。

**可信度三级**，写在数据里，不藏：

- `verified` 已交叉印证 —— ≥2 个独立来源，且必须填 `source`（自检强制检查）
- `community` 社区共识 —— 无官方统一口径，存在多种写法
- `experience` 经验值 —— 需复核

---

## 输出长什么样

每条问题分三级（`[X] 错误` / `[!] 警告` / `[i] 提示`），每条带**具体修法**，最后给一句**行动结论**——因为用户真正要的不是问题清单，而是"我现在该干什么"：

```
结论: 救不了：尺寸和比例都不对，只能按目标规格重新出图
结论: 救不了：像素不足，必须从源文件按更大尺寸重新导出（放大无效）
结论: 能救：转换格式即可，画质不受影响
```

### 多图连发：指出改哪一张

一次传多张时（小红书最多 18 图、微博九宫格），**单张全达标但整组不整齐**是最常见的翻车方式。本工具会做一次跨文件的组级检查，并且**点出少数派是哪一张**，而不是甩一句"三张都不一致"：

```
============================================================
多图一致性检查（共 3 张）

  [X]  小红书 —— 不能发布
        [X] 尺寸不统一：1242×1660(2张)、1080×1440(1张)
        >> 结论: 这一组的主因是 cover3.png 的尺寸和其余不一致……
                 统一按同一规格重导一遍即可，不用逐张处理。
```

问题清单不值钱，**指出改哪一张才值钱**。

---

## 作为 Agent Skill 使用

本仓库同时是一个可用的 Agent Skill（适配 WorkBuddy / Claude 等支持 `SKILL.md` 的平台）。

```bash
# 安装到用户级 skills 目录
cp -r . ~/.workbuddy-ai/skills/publish-size-check/
```

装好后有两种触发方式：

**① 直接问** —— 用户给了文件并问到发布尺寸：

> 「这图发小红书会不会糊」「平台要多大尺寸」「dpi 够吗」「投稿插图够不够清晰」「被退回来说分辨率不够」

**② 寄生自检（覆盖面最大的用法）** —— 出图流程结束后自动跑，用户不需要知道这个技能存在：

```
用户: 帮我做一张小红书封面
  ↓
[出图技能] 生成封面文件
  ↓
★ 有文件落盘 + 用户提到了发布平台 → 自动体检
  ↓
"封面已生成：1242×1660。顺带确认过小红书规格，可以直接发。"
```

汇报是**分级**的：通过就一句话带过，有问题才展开细节并**给出替代方案**（"要我按规格重新出一版吗？"）。用户没要求体检时，不会甩一份 30 行诊断打断体验。

`SKILL.md` 里有完整的触发协议、协作边界和扩展指南。

---

## 作为 CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy 插件安装

本仓库同时是一个**插件市场（marketplace）**，可以一条命令装进 CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy：

```bash
# 1. 添加本仓库作为插件市场
/plugin marketplace add Stephen-pc/publish-size-check

# 2. 安装插件
/plugin install publish-check@publish-size-check

# 3. 立即生效，无需重启
/reload-plugins
```

装好后技能即刻可用，触发方式和上面的 Agent Skill 完全一致。

### 与「直接复制 skill」的区别

| | 复制 SKILL.md | 装成插件 |
|---|---|---|
| 升级 | 手动重拷 | `/plugin update publish-check@publish-size-check` |
| 团队分发 | 各自拷贝 | 写进 `.codebuddy/settings.json`，协作者自动获得 |
| 组件命名空间 | 无 | `publish-check:publish-check` |
| 适用场景 | 单人、临时试 | 长期使用、团队统一 |

### 本地开发 / 不联网安装

```bash
/plugin marketplace add ./publish-size-check
/plugin install publish-check@publish-size-check
```

### 仓库结构（双入口）

```
publish-size-check/
├── .codebuddy-plugin/
│   └── marketplace.json          # 市场清单：声明本仓库提供哪些插件
├── plugins/
│   └── publish-check/            # 插件包（会被复制进版本化 cache）
│       ├── .codebuddy-plugin/
│       │   └── plugin.json       # 插件清单
│       ├── LICENSE
│       └── skills/
│           └── publish-check/    # ← 技能本体，与仓库根目录内容一致
│               ├── SKILL.md
│               ├── demo.py
│               ├── scripts/
│               └── references/
├── SKILL.md                      # 仓库根目录 = 直接可用的技能形态
├── scripts/
├── references/
└── demo.py
```

根目录保留技能形态，是为了**不装插件的人也能直接 `cp -r` 使用**；`plugins/publish-check/` 是插件形态。两处的技能文件**内容逐字节相同**（CI 会校验），改完记得同步：

```bash
cp SKILL.md demo.py plugins/publish-check/skills/publish-check/
cp scripts/*.py plugins/publish-check/skills/publish-check/scripts/
cp references/platforms.json plugins/publish-check/skills/publish-check/references/
```

### 为什么没有做成完整插件市场里的「原生插件」

插件还能挂 `commands/`、`agents/`、`hooks/`、MCP server。本工具**故意不挂**：

- 不需要 hook —— 寄生自检靠 `SKILL.md` 里的触发协议，装了插件就自动生效，不需要在用户机器上跑钩子。
- 不需要 MCP server —— 那要求常驻进程和 stdio 协议，与「零依赖、跑完就退出」的设计冲突。
- 不需要 command —— 技能本身就能被自然语言触发，多一个斜杠命令只是多一个要维护的入口。

**能少挂一个组件就少挂一个** —— 每挂一个，用户装之前的信任成本就高一档。

---

## 作为 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件安装

本仓库同时是一个 **dsh 插件包**，可以直接装进 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Stephen-pc/publish-size-check
```

装好后 `publish-check` 会出现在技能目录里，触发方式和上面的 Agent Skill 完全一致。

也可以从 [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) 一键安装 —— 它内置的插件列表 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 收录了本插件。

### 它长什么样

```
publish-size-check/
├── package.json          # 声明 dsh.bundle
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle patch 层：往 profile 树插一条 loader entry
├── lib/index.js          # 技能 provider：把 SKILL.md 挂到 ctx.skills
├── tools/dsh-selftest.mjs
└── SKILL.md              # ← 与仓库根是同一份
```

`lib/index.js` 是一层**很薄的接线**，不是第二个实现：

- **零依赖** —— 只 import `node:fs/promises` / `node:url` / `node:path`，与 `scripts/spec.py` 只用 Python 标准库是同一个原则。
- **不复制正文** —— 候选和正文都在调用时从 `SKILL.md` 现读，改正文不必动这个文件，也不会出现「描述与正文两份、各自漂移」。
- **不覆盖本地版本** —— 它报 `bundled` 秩（600），你在 `~/.dsh/skills/publish-check` 放的本地特化版（`user-dsh` = 400）仍然优先。

判定逻辑始终只有一份，在 `scripts/spec.py`。

### 一个容易踩的坑：`{skill_base}`

`SKILL.md` 正文里写的是 `python {skill_base}/scripts/spec.py` —— `{skill_base}` 是 CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy 形态的占位符，宿主会在运行时替换它。

**dsh 不认这个占位符。** 它走的是另一套机制：provider 报一个 `resourceBase`，宿主把基准目录写进 `<skill_resources>`，并要求模型「把技能里提到的相对路径解析到基准目录下」。

所以 provider 在 `get()` 时把 `{skill_base}/` 削掉，正文里留下的是 dsh 惯例的裸相对路径（基准目录 = 包根）：

```bash
python scripts/spec.py --check cover.png
```

不这么做的话，模型会拿到一条执行不了的命令。削成相对路径、而不是替换成绝对路径，是因为 Windows 绝对路径带反斜杠，写进代码块后在 bash 里会被当成转义字符。

### 自检

```bash
node tools/dsh-selftest.mjs
```

用一个假 `ctx` 走完 `apply()` → `list()` → `get()`，并验证正文引用的相对路径真的落在包根下。CI 还会 `npm pack` 解压后**按安装形态再跑一遍** —— 抓的是 `files` 字段漏文件这类只有用户才会撞上的错。

想更彻底一点，可以拉起官方运行时真的加载一次（需要联网装依赖，不进 CI）：

```bash
cd /tmp && npm init -y
npm install @deepseek-ai/cordis@~4.0.4 @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill@0.2.0-rc.2 \
            @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm@0.2.0-rc.2 @deepseek-ai/dsh-scope@0.2.0-rc.2
node <本仓库>/tools/dsh-real-load.mjs <本仓库>
```

它会走 `ctx.skills.get()` → `renderSkillContent()`，把**模型最终收到的那段文本**打出来——包括上面那条基准目录说明。

---

## 这个工具**不**做什么（重要）

**只查几何参数。不查内容合规。**

| 查 | 不查 |
|---|---|
| 像素尺寸、宽高比 | ❌ 内容是否违规 |
| dpi、实际印刷宽度 | ❌ 是否含二维码/联系方式（平台限流项） |
| 文件体积、格式 | ❌ 文字占画面比例 |
| 色彩模式要求 | ❌ 字体版权、图片版权、商标 |
| 多图尺寸一致性 | ❌ 医疗/金融等特殊行业资质标识 |

**不查的那些不是不重要，是本工具做不到。** 范围窄是刻意的——正因如此才能做到零依赖、结果确定、不误判内容。

其它边界：

- **原件只读**。永不修改、移动、重命名、删除任何输入文件。只诊断，不代改。
- **不给有害建议**。绝不说"把 640px 的图缩到 200px"——尺寸不足只能重做，放大无法恢复清晰度。
- **不猜图类型**。判断不了的事（如投稿图是照片还是线条图）会让你选，而不是并列报一堆矛盾结论。
- **不猜规格**。规格库没有的平台用通

plugins.readme_text:
# 腾讯会议 DSH 插件

标准 Cordis Host 插件/DSH bundle，Node.js 原生实现，无 Python、无安装脚本。不附带任何账号或 Token，不读取原 skill 目录或其 `.env`。

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/sibetlyf/dsh-plugin-tencent-meeting.git
```

亦可在 DSH 插件页输入本地绝对路径安装。发布后可将路径替换为实际 npm 包名或 Git 仓库地址。当前仅声明兼容 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1，其他版本需要另行测试，勿绕过兼容性限制。

## 用户手动输入 Token

1. 用户自行访问 https://meeting.tencent.com/ai-skill 获取个人 Token。
2. 打开 DSH 插件设置中的 **腾讯会议**，在 `tokenRef` 对应的凭据输入控件中输入自己的 Token。默认凭据名称为 `DSH_TENCENT_MEETING_TOKEN`。
3. `tokenRef` 配置保存的是引用名称，不是 Token。Token 保存在 DSH 本地凭据服务管理的存储中，不进入插件包、配置补丁或工具参数。
4. 凭据 UI 若在当前版本不可用，可自行设置同名启动环境变量后重启 DSH。不应把 Token 发到聊天。

插件不会自动迁移 `TENCENT_MEETING_TOKEN` 或旧 skill 的 `.env`；使用独立的新引用防止误用旧凭据。没有 Token 仍可安装并查看配置状态；首次真正查询才需要鉴权。

## 使用

加载 `tencent-meeting` skill；调用 `tencent_meeting_discover` 列出动作，传 action 获取官方 inputSchema；`tencent_meeting_call` 执行准确 action 和 arguments。`statusOnly: true` 只返回凭据是否配置，不联网，不返回值。

工具参数按需加载，避免每个模型请求都带上几十个完整远端 schema。官方 schema 由服务端负责参数校验，插件额外检查关键批量限制。HTTP POST 格式沿用原 skill 的官方 JSON-RPC 接口，不假装完成了 Streamable HTTP 协议协商。

## 安全

- 请求只能发往代码内固定的腾讯会议官方 HTTPS 地址，禁止重定向；无自定义 endpoint。
- 每次操作通过 DSH 凭据服务重新读取凭据，不缓存、不输出、不写日志。
- 返回中 Token、授权、密码字段以及当前 Token 明文会脱敏。
- 写入、通讯录及未知操作必须通过 DSH approval；`never` 策略下拒绝，不发送业务请求。确认摘要不得含个人电话、邮箱、内部 ID、Token。
- 录制申请的 prepare/commit、参与者校验及通讯录意图等多步业务约束在 skill 中明确要求；插件并未通过持久状态机器证明模型已执行这些前置步骤。通讯录 meetingIntent 是模型声明，不是意图鉴别器。
- 不自动反馈、更新或重试；网络错误不打印请求头。响应最多 4 MiB、超时最多 120 秒。
- 工具结果可能包含私人会议内容并进入当前会话历史；请保护 DSH 本地数据。

## 开发与发布

```powershell
npm run check
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
npm pack
```

包文件白名单排除 `.env`、测试、缓存、node_modules。图标为本项目原创通用摄像机图形，不是腾讯商标。插件实现及说明重新编写；未复制官方 skill 源码或参考文件。依赖采用 DSH 已提供的 peer package，无 build scripts。

公开源码仓库：https://github.com/sibetlyf/dsh-plugin-tencent-meeting 。尚未发布到 npm；dsh.so 市场收录状态以平台审核结果为准。真实腾讯接口仅在用户手动配置 Token 后验证；自动测试只使用模拟响应，不读取用户秘密。
